title: State Dependent Parallel Neural Hawkes Process for Limit Order Book Event Stream Prediction and Simulation

problem.claim: Predicting limit order book events and simulating realistic limit order book data.

contributions.claim: A state-dependent parallel neural Hawkes process for limit order book event prediction and simulation.
Separate intensity-rate modeling for each event type using parallel continuous-time LSTM units, combined with an event-state interaction mechanism.
A deep-learning-based limit order book simulator developed through stochastic point sampling from a trained model.

stated_novelty.claim: The authors propose a novel state-dependent parallel neural Hawkes process.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The proposed model is reported to outperform traditional stochastic and deep learning models for predicting event type and time on a real-world limit order book dataset.
The simulator is reported to exhibit multiple stylized facts found in real limit order book data.

narrative_sequence.summary: Limit order books are event-based, continuously updating systems recording contemporaneous demand and supply for financial assets.
The authors propose a state-dependent parallel neural Hawkes process with separate event-type intensity modeling and event-state interactions.
The model is evaluated for event type and time prediction against traditional stochastic and deep learning models on real-world limit order book data.
Stochastic point sampling from the trained model is used to build a simulator exhibiting stylized facts of real limit order book data.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify the event types, dataset details, baselines, evaluation metrics, or quantitative results.
The abstract does not describe the stylized facts reproduced by the simulator or the sampling procedure in detail.
